channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jordi Fernandez | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jordi Fernandez from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Chaney Johnson on Jordi Fernandez
item.description:
Chaney Johnson:

“Coach Jordi (Fernandez), he was literally one of the most positive coaches in the locker room, win or loss. So you can tell how much he cares about winning, but he cares about his players just as much. So, I mean, he is a winner and I feel like of course it just hasn't went his way, but like he hasn't taken his foot off the gas. So, they they keep your head up, man, like but just keep believing. Just keep believing, that's all I can say, just keep believing.”

Chaney Johnson on Jordi Fernandez, Aug 25, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Sean Marks on Jordi Fernandez
item.description:
“I think we all we control is our path. I think we set out on this a couple of years ago, and I think I’m very happy with what the group has done, what Jordi (Fernandez), the coaching staff, have done to develop these young men, and it’s gonna be really exciting to see what they look like, and you know, whether it’s a year or two years from here, and who really seizes this opportunity?”

Sean Marks on Jordi Fernandez, Aug 17, 2026. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Sean Marks on Jordi Fernandez
item.description:
Brooklyn Nets GM Sean Marks on signing head coach Jordi Fernandez and his entire coaching staff to multi-year extensions:

“Jordi is a tremendous leader who, along with his coaching staff, put his stamp on this franchise from the moment he arrived in Brooklyn. Over his first two seasons, Jordi has built a strong foundation rooted in player development, a competitive spirit and honest communication, all of which have been embraced throughout our roster. The energy and passion the entire staff relentlessly pour into our players reverberates throughout the organization, and we are excited to have this group continue to lead our franchise into the future.”

Sean Marks on Jordi Fernandez, Apr 20, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Cam Johnson on Jordi Fernandez
item.description:
Cam Johnson on Jordi Fernandez and the Brooklyn Nets:

“I have so much respect for that coaching staff in Brooklyn. I really loved playing for Jordi. I think Jordi has a tremendously bright future in this league. I think Brooklyn has a bright future. Those are my guys for sure.”

Cam Johnson on Jordi Fernandez, Jul 18, 2025. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Sean Marks on Jordi Fernandez
item.description:
Sean Marks on Jordi Fernandez's mentality:

“It's going to be go out there and compete. Jordi knows that, and the coaching staff knows that... You guys go compete, and you build a competitive culture. I'm never gonna tell them to not do that.”

Sean Marks on Jordi Fernandez, Jan 2, 2025. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Ja Morant on Jordi Fernandez
item.description:
Ja Morant on his interaction with Jordi Fernandez:

“I was trolling, just to get them riled up, and I did... I didn't say nothing crazy. If you look at the video, I was just saying 'yeah.' If 'yeah' is disrespectful or makes you feel some type of way, then hey, so be it.”

Ja Morant on Jordi Fernandez, Dec 14, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Trendon Watford on Jordi Fernandez
item.description:
Trendon Watford on the Nets' confidence shooting from deep under Jordi Fernández:

“I don't think there's a coach that tells us to shoot as much as him. He came to me before the game and said he wanted me to shoot 10 threes. I let him down, I only shot 6”

Trendon Watford on Jordi Fernandez, Nov 28, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Cameron Johnson on Jordi Fernandez
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Cam Johnson:

“There’s plenty to work on in the meantime, plenty of things to focus on. So I’m having conversations with Jordi (Fernandez) and then as if I’m fully 100% on the team all the way through. That’s where I want to be right now, and I’m cool with that.”

Cameron Johnson on Jordi Fernandez, Jul 14, 2024. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Chima Moneke on Jordi Fernandez
item.description:
“But my agent told me it was going to happen. Brown brought the two assistant coaches from Nigeria, and I had a great relationship with them. The reason I came to Manresa is Jordi Fernandez. I have a close relationship with him, and he is the biggest reason it happened this time, too,”

Chima Moneke on Jordi Fernandez, Jul 20, 2022. Source: BasketNews.
